cleanup.reason: Remove only owned, unused, reconstructible intermediates after completed training; remove the failed partial guest copy. Preserve source/profile/trace/result inputs and selected optimized binaries.

profiles.scope: Transparent filesystem compression of this experiment own immutable raw profile inputs only. Verify every file against its recorded SHA before and after. No profile bytes or paths removed; no source/result/trace files modified. Run after timed measurements finish.

storage_recovery.scope: Initial guest disk copy failed before boot when the filesystem filled. Preserve failed receipts; resume the original live replay. Retry the guest with a byte-verified APFS clone. Remove only unused reconstructible training binaries and the failed partial disk; preserve all source, profiles, traces and result data.
